name: Airlogix
desc: Ukrainian maker of reconnaissance and strike drones, producing in Ukraine, Germany, Canada and the UK.
markets: Ukraine's armed forces, with production joint ventures in Germany, Canada and the UK
talks: Forbes reported, citing two sources, that Airlogix is in talks to raise USD 100M at a valuation above USD 2B; the company declined to comment.
status_detail: No announcement found; last seen reported by DroneXL on 11 Oct 2026 (citing Forbes, 9 Oct).
rationale: Fast-scaling European defence manufacturer building international profile; F1 visibility could aid recruitment and allied-government brand building.

name: Pyra
desc: Pre-launch defence software start-up unifying battlefield and intelligence data and linking separate defence systems.
markets: UK Ministry of Defence and allied governments
talks: The Financial Times (via Sifted) reported that Pyra, founded by Nick Blair, is seeking about USD 200M; terms under discussion and could change.
raised_so_far: No prior funding reported (company incorporated Nov 2025), per The Investor Society
status_detail: No announcement of a closed round found; last seen reported mid-Aug 2026.
rationale: High-profile founder and large raise; British defence brand could use F1 for hospitality with government and industry buyers.

name: Destinus
desc: Dutch maker of cruise missiles and autonomous long-range strike drones, with a Rheinmetall missile joint venture.
markets: Ukraine's armed forces and European NATO governments, with production in Europe
talks: Bloomberg reported Destinus seeks about EUR 200M (about USD 232M at ~1.16) in pre-IPO funding at a valuation above EUR 5B, advised by Rothschild and UniCredit, ahead of a possible Amsterdam listing.
raised_so_far: Nearly EUR 400M to date incl. convertible notes at a valuation above EUR 1B (Dealroom's profile lists USD 183M), per Dealroom News
status_detail: No closing announced. On 20 Oct 2026 Helsing announced a partnership and participation in a Destinus funding round; Bloomberg (people familiar) put the valuation at about EUR 6B, size undisclosed and no final decisions made. Already above both lines on reported figures.
rationale: Pre-IPO European defence group seeking investor and public profile; an F1 deal could support listing visibility, though weapons branding limits fit.

name: Frankenburg Technologies
desc: Estonian start-up mass-producing low-cost missiles and interceptors for air defence against drones and missiles.
markets: Estonia, Ukraine and European NATO armed forces
talks: Bloomberg reported Frankenburg is seeking a fresh EUR 100M Series B (about USD 116M) that could make it a unicorn; Resilience Media confirmed details with a company source.
raised_so_far: About EUR 40M in total incl. EUR 30M Series A led by Plural (Feb 2026), per Tech.eu search snippet; Series A valuation around USD 400M per Resilience Media sources
status_detail: No Series B announcement found; last seen reported 22 Jun 2026 (USD conversions at ~1.16 per EUR).
rationale: Fast-growing European air-defence maker; F1 hospitality could reach NATO procurement and political audiences across Europe.

name: Endurance Energy
desc: Start-up developing power plants that tap geothermal heat from the ocean floor to generate electricity.
markets: Pre-commercial; targeting large-scale electricity supply, initially in the United States
talks: Axios Pro reported, citing two sources, that Endurance Energy is raising about USD 150M in Series B funding for subsea offshore geothermal.
raised_so_far: USD 54M Series A led by Founders Fund (Jun 2026), per TechCrunch
rationale: Early-stage energy firm; F1 sustainability narrative fits, but it is pre-revenue with little consumer brand need.

name: DG Matrix
desc: Maker of solid-state transformers and power-routing hardware for grids, data centres and EV charging.
markets: US utilities, data centres and charging operators
talks: Axios Pro headline reported DG Matrix is raising USD 250M for solid-state transformers (body text not seen).
raised_so_far: USD 60M Series A led by The Engine Ventures (Feb 2026), bringing total to USD 100M, per search summary of FinSMEs/MarketScreener
status_detail: Reported 30 Oct 2026 (Axios Pro); no announcement found.
rationale: Grid hardware supplier to data centres; F1 tech-partner storytelling could aid B2B brand building, but fit is weak.

name: XGS Energy
desc: Geothermal developer using closed-loop systems to produce firm power for utilities and data centres.
markets: US western states utilities and data-centre power buyers
talks: Axios Pro scoop: XGS Energy is preparing to raise USD 300M in private funding, planning to begin the raise in September.
status_detail: No announcement found in a Nov 2026 search; last seen reported 18 Aug 2026.
rationale: Clean firm-power developer courting data-centre buyers; F1 sustainability platform possible but B2B and US-domestic focus.

name: Gauss Fusion
desc: German developer of stellarator fusion power plants, backed by European industrial partners.
markets: Europe, now pitching US investors; future utility power buyers
talks: Axios Pro reported German fusion start-up Gauss Fusion is pitching US investors on a USD 150M Series A round.
raised_so_far: Undisclosed seed-to-A financing from founders, industrial partners and shareholders, per Innovation News Network
status_detail: Company said on 19 Oct 2026 it had commenced Series A fundraising (target undisclosed); no close announced.
rationale: Fusion firms seek high-tech prestige; F1 engineering link could attract talent and industrial partners, though still pre-revenue.
